retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style outdoor portrait featuring a man in winter gear with large, stylized swash lettering overlapping the subject.
triggerTerms: fur parka portrait with swash type

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a man wearing a fur-lined parka and a black cowboy hat against a backdrop of bare winter trees, dominated by large, blue, decorative swash lettering across the top half.
coreVisualRelationships: Large decorative title overlapping the subject's hat
Subject positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame
Cool blue tones in the background and type contrasting with warm fur textures
Secondary text placed above the primary title
coreInvariants: Large blue swash lettering with white outlines
Subject wearing a fur-lined hood and cowboy hat
Winter forest background with bare branches

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium close-up, occupying the center and bottom right, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized blue title across the top third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large blue title, move down to the subject's face, and then to the texture of the fur collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense background of branches provides a textured negative space behind the subject and type.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and tans of the parka and fur.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue of the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White outlines on text and highlights in the snow/branches.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photograph with high-value highlights; high saturation in the blue graphic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Thick white outline around solid blue fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: W and S feature elongated, circular curls
L and D stems are integrated into the flow of adjacent swashes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, custom display face paired with a simpler, outlined slab serif for the artist name.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and era-appropriate curves

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a brown parka with a thick fur hood and a black cowboy hat, standing in a winter forest with bare, snow-dusted branches.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, blue, custom-lettered display text across the top with heavy white outlines and exaggerated swashes on the first and last letters.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have large, curling swashes?
Is the subject wearing a fur-lined hood?
Is the color palette dominated by blue and brown?
Does the text overlap the subject's hat?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue in the typography

avoid: Clean vector lines in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography has a thick white border
Verify the '70s film aesthetic is maintained
Confirm the cowboy hat is clearly visible under the type
recipe.reuseFormula: Outdoor portrait + 70s film stock + oversized swash typography = Vintage Americana Album Cover
